note: The original describes the species under the new combination Afrograllatotermes africanus (Harris): that paper moves this species, previously placed in Grallatotermes, to the new genus Afrograllatotermes and explicitly notes =Grallatotermes africanus Harris, 1954, the same species as the name used here. The material is topotypes and paratypes of the type series (1 imago, 5 soldiers, 4 workers) from an arboreal nest at Ngameni, north-eastern Tanganyika. The original gives no measurements.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, postclypeus the same colour as the head. Head width (including the compound eyes) greater than head length (to the posterior margin of the postclypeus); frontal region concave; compound eyes large; ocelli large, oval, almost touching the compound eye; postclypeus length slightly less than half its width; mandibles as in the worker. Pronotum width equal to the head width (including the compound eyes); wings densely covered with minute stellate papillae and with numerous short hairs. Abdomen uniformly covered with pale short hairs.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head broadly pyriform in dorsal view, with a distinct depression near the middle in lateral view; a weak constriction behind the antennal bases; rostrum weakly conical, slightly upturned in lateral view; antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 only slightly longer than segment 2; mandibles reduced, each with a short toothless blade rudiment; each mandible with a pale transparent chitinous spot distal to the molar region. Pronotum saddle-shaped.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head broadly oval, cranial suture distinct. Fontanelle plate triangular, white, almost central. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 as long as segment 2. Postclypeus swollen, its length slightly less than half its width. Left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth as long as, not shorter than, the 1st marginal tooth, left mandible index 0.35, the angle between the apical and 1st marginal teeth about 45°; 1st marginal tooth large, its posterior margin weakly wavy, a sharp notch before the 2nd marginal tooth, the 2nd marginal tooth small and distinct. Right mandible also with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth as long as the 1st marginal tooth; right mandible index 0.81; 1st marginal tooth large, its anterior margin slightly straight, posterior margin weakly wavy; 2nd marginal tooth short, its posterior margin nearly 3 times the anterior margin; molar region large, as long as the rest of the mandible (index 1.0), strongly serrate.
